name.ja: ENTRY GRADE 仮面ライダーセイバー

ja: 全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に仮面ライダーセイバーが登場！
■タッチゲートだからパーツは手で“プチッ！”と取れる！
■シンプルなパーツ数（約36パーツ）ながら、各部位の特徴的な色分けもしっかり表現。
■剣を持った手と握りこぶしの2種類の右手を付属し、付け替えが楽しめる！
■接着剤や工具は不要。説明書は見やすい色付き。
en: Kamen Rider Saber appears in the introductory series "ENTRY GRADE" given to all plastic model inexperienced people!
• Because it is a touch gate, parts can be removed by hand!
• Although the number of parts is simple (approximately 36 parts), the characteristic color coding of each part is well expressed.
• Two types of right hands are included, one with a sword and one with a clenched fist, so you can enjoy swapping them out!
• No glue or tools required. The manual is colored for easy viewing.
